name: Intent Relay
stage: Planning; task contracts prepared, execution and product implementation not approved or completed

waves.title: Describe the effects before the calls
waves.outcome: Define a minimal contract around intent and consequences.

waves.title: A synthetic workflow with real semantics
waves.outcome: Implement the smallest inspectable multi-service run.

waves.title: Work across teams and frameworks
waves.outcome: Keep permissions and meaning stable as adoption grows.

waves.outcome: Make operational reliability a maintained community asset.

tasks.title: Specify operation and approval contracts
tasks.goal: Model read, prepare, commit, reconcile and compensate where a provider supports them.
acceptanceCriteria: Three example operations explicitly declare permissions and reversibility limits.
An approval binds to the proposed arguments and becomes invalid when they change.
tasks.body:
Model read, prepare, commit, reconcile and compensate where a provider supports them.

acceptanceCriteria: Each scenario states what is known, unknown and safe to try next.
